headline: G-DRAGON's 'Good Day' returns with 3RACHA on board
sub: Season 2 set for early 2027, with GD as executive producer

points.title: Producer lineup
items: Stray Kids' 3RACHA: Bang Chan, Changbin, Han
Park Myung-soo also joins the lineup

caption:
G-DRAGON's music variety show 'Good Day' is coming back for season 2!

Production company TEO confirmed the new season, set for the first half of 2027 with PD Kim Tae-ho. G-DRAGON leads as executive producer and makes an album with six producers: Stray Kids' 3RACHA, (G)I-DLE's Soyeon, Code Kunst, JANNABI's Choi Jung-hoon, Hanroro and Park Myung-soo. As in season 1, proceeds from the songs will be donated. The performers have not been announced yet.

📌 Source: TEO, via Korean media (TenAsia, Etoday, Sports Kyunghyang)
